hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: CONNECTION_LABEL
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: The connection your super admin user will use to authenticate.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
MYSQL_RUN="docker run --rm -i -v $MYSQL_CONFIG_DIR/.my.cnf:/root/.my.cnf --network=${MYSQL_NETWORK:-host} mysql mysql"
# Reuse the existing user if one already exists for this email + connection export USER_ID_HEX=`$MYSQL_RUN -N -B -e \ "SELECT hex(uuid) FROM user WHERE email='$EMAIL' AND connectionId=(select uuid from connection where label='$CONNECTION_LABEL');" auth`
if [ -n "$USER_ID_HEX" ]; then echo "Admin user $EMAIL already exists ($USER_ID_HEX); reusing it." $MYSQL_RUN -e "UPDATE user SET is_active=1 WHERE uuid=unhex('$USER_ID_HEX');" auth else export USER_ID=`uuidgen -r` export USER_ID_HEX=`echo $USER_ID | awk '{ print toupper($0) }'|sed 's/-//g'` $MYSQL_RUN -e \ "INSERT INTO auth.user (uuid, auth0_metadata, general_metadata, acceptedTOS, connectionId, email, matched, subject, is_active, long_term_token) VALUES (unhex('$USER_ID_HEX'), null, '{\"email\":\"$EMAIL\"}', null, (select uuid from connection where label='$CONNECTION_LABEL'),'$EMAIL',0,null,1,null);" auth fi
# Grant each admin role (looked up by name) unless the user already has it, then confirm it was granted for ROLE_NAME in "PIC-SURE Top Admin" "PIC-SURE User"; do $MYSQL_RUN -e \ "INSERT INTO user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT unhex('$USER_ID_HEX'), r.uuid FROM role r WHERE r.name='$ROLE_NAME' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id=unhex('$USER_ID_HEX') AND ur.role_id=r.uuid);" auth HAS_ROLE=`$MYSQL_RUN -N -B -e \ "SELECT 1 FROM user_role ur JOIN role r ON r.uuid=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=unhex('$USER_ID_HEX') AND r.name='$ROLE_NAME';" auth` if [ -z "$HAS_ROLE" ]; then echo "Failed to grant role '$ROLE_NAME' to $EMAIL; does the role exist in auth.role?" exit 1 fi done
